schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE customers (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE orders (id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), order_date DATE NOT NULL, total_amount NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE order_items (id INT PRIMARY KEY, order_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id), sku TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL, unit_price NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL);

workload.query_text: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 100 ORDER BY line_total DESC
